project.name: NeuronLine
project.summary: TypeScript workspace for privacy-first browser-local online learning, predictor modules, demo applications, and personalization package APIs.
goals: Provide lightweight online-learning primitives for real-time, local, privacy-preserving personalization.
Keep core learners, predictor modules, demos, tests, and package exports modular and tree-shakeable.
Support experimentation with bandits, A/B testing, recommendations, and browser-local prediction without moving consumer product data out of the browser.
nonGoals: Own consumer product recommendation policy, analytics collection policy, user consent, or production experimentation governance.
Own server-side ML platforms, centralized user profile storage, or cross-product data pipelines.
Own enterprise doctrine, manifest schema, rollout planning, org rulesets, or shared CI policy.

owns.name: neuronline-core
owns.description: Core online-learning engine, immutable state primitives, math utilities, bandit implementations, replay buffers, and learner tests.

owns.name: neuronline-predictors
owns.description: Prediction modules for click, sequence, recommender, feature extraction, and A/B testing package exports.

owns.name: neuronline-demo-and-docs
owns.description: Demo application, README, improvement notes, package metadata, and development scripts for NeuronLine consumers.

doesNotOwn: Consumer product recommendation policy, analytics collection policy, user consent, or production experimentation governance.
Server-side ML platforms, centralized user profile storage, model hosting, or cross-product data pipelines.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared delivery policy.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit

forbiddenCouplings: Do not encode a consumer product's recommendation policy, consent model, or analytics rules into NeuronLine core.
Do not move browser-local personalization data into centralized storage from this repository.
Do not expose package consumers to internal source paths instead of declared package exports.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine.

delivery.deployPath: No package publish, demo deploy, or release workflow is declared in this repository.
delivery.productionProof: Package build/test/typecheck, bundle size, browser-local privacy proof, package readback, and demo smoke evidence are not yet declared as a durable release gate.

gaps.description: Add or document pull-request validation for bun install, test, build, typecheck, lint, package exports, and demo smoke.
Document package publication, bundle-size, package readback, privacy proof, and consumer smoke evidence before release.
Document how consuming products own consent, analytics collection policy, recommendation policy, and experimentation governance.
